The brief

An ABA therapy provider serving families across Canada, with service pages and city landing pages built for local search. The goal was a website that loads fast, explains every service clearly and turns local searches into calls and bookings.

What I did

  • Website development and ongoing updates on WordPress, with responsive layouts for mobile, tablet and desktop.
  • Keyword research and on-page SEO for the main service pages: titles, meta descriptions, headings and internal links.
  • Technical SEO: indexing checks, site speed and structured data (schema markup).
  • Local SEO: location-focused content and local citations for Mississauga, Ontario.
  • AEO & GEO: FAQ content and FAQPage schema, written as clear answers that search engines and AI tools can quote.

Highlights

  • 27 city landing pages across Ontario, British Columbia, Alberta and Manitoba
  • MedicalBusiness, FAQPage and ItemList schema on the live site
  • Brand videos for social media
